question: Who among the following presidents of India gave assent to the 100th Amendment of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pranab Mukherjee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Pranab Mukherjee gave assent to the 100th Amendment of the Constitution of India.
 
• The 100th amendment of the Indian constitution deals with the Land Boundary Agreement.
 
• In the Agreement exchange of certain enclave territories with Bangladesh and the conferment of citizenship rights to residents of those enclaves took place between India and Bangladesh.
 
• The Land Boundary Agreement was signed in Bangladesh in the year 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pranab Kumar Mukherjee was an Indian politician and statesman.

 
 
• He served as the 13th President of India from 2012-to 2017.
 
• He was preceded by Pratibha Patil and was succeeded by Ram Nath Govind.
 
• He received Padma Vibhushan in the year 2008 and Bharat Ratna in the year 2019.
 
• Books: Challenges Before the Nation: A Saga of Struggle and Sacrifice, Beyond Survival: Emerging Dimensions of the Indian Economy.
